evidence_guards: No exact coordinates, route geometry, biographies, images or automatic publication.
Budslaŭ UNESCO fest is attested by UNESCO as a cultural practice; this does not certify supernatural apparitions.
Medjugorje 2024 Vatican nihil obstat permits public devotion, not supernatural event approval.
Customs outside French Catholic world are separate regional heritage, not imported as French domestic practice.
Site Catholic, Orthodox, historic, national or civic ownership must remain explicit when cross-referencing.
Canonical IDs and duplicates must be reconciled against both current main and previous Europe wave before promotion.
